messages:
ops-oncall: noticed a surge in controller-manager reconcile latency starting ~12:10 UTC in us-west1. apiserver 503 rates ticked up and many controllers log lease wait/timeouts. GPU attach jobs also spiking around same time. anyone digging?
lin: on it. seeing `Failed to acquire lease` loops in controller-manager. sample: 
```
E 12:11:03 controller-leader.go:142 failed to acquire lease: timed out waiting for lock
I 12:11:04 controller-runtime.manager Starting controllers...
W 12:11:05 reconciler.go:87 reconcile took 2.7s for PodAttach, want <50ms
```
maria: etctd WAL iops show a sharp spike coincident with attach activity. looks like snapshotting/compaction hasn't run in 2 days.
ashley: can we short-circuit non-critical controllers while we triage? can enable `--leader-elect=false` for some noisy controllers for now (risky) or scale them down.
dan: suggestion: throttle attach controller concurrency and bump KV compaction schedule. I can push a compaction job to rotate WALs and drop tombstones.
kevin: FYI we had a large GPU reclaim/attach job from infra-rebalance at 12:05 that retried a bunch when attach throttled, might be the root. I'm pausing the rebalance.
ops-oncall: thanks kevin, pausing now. rolling a quick patch to reduce attach retries to 3 from 10.
lin: short-term mitigation: reduce controller concurrency for `gpu-attach-controller` to 5 -> applied. apiserver 503s dropping but not gone.
sre-bot: alert: apiserver_503_rate (us-west1) down from 2.4% -> 0.9% in last 3m :thumbsup:
ashley: for next steps we should: 1) run `etcdctl defrag` on followers, 2) schedule compaction at a quieter window, 3) add KV cache warming for attach hot paths.
dan: running `etcdctl snapshot status` and `defrag` on follower nodes now. command: `ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=<follower> snapshot status /var/lib/etcd/member/snap/db`
maria: also saw many long-lived apiserver connections from the GPU attach process causing proxy fd saturation. increasing proxy connection pool and tuning keepalive helps.
kevin: going to stagger future rebalances so they respect a cluster-wide lease-rate limit. ops, open a ticket to add admission throttle for attach operations.
ops-oncall: created ticket INF-4382 for attach rate-limiter + postmortem. will keep watchers posted.
lin: follow-up: controller-manager metrics show median reconcile back to ~40ms after defrag + concurrency change. I'll keep an eye for 30m.
ashley: we'll schedule a controlled compaction and an attach retry backoff change tomorrow.
ops-oncall: summary: root likely attach storm from scheduled GPU rebalance + stale etcd compaction -> WAL iops spike -> leader election/lease waits -> controller reconcile latency -> apiserver 503s. mitigations applied: paused rebalance, reduced controller concurrency, defragbed etcd followers, tuned proxy, filed ticket. closing thread unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
